entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-03
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Using EF 10-rc.1 with Dapper in same transaction requires to set TransactionManager.ImplicitDistributedTransactions = true #36911
  • ExecuteUpdate is losing tags depending on how null value is passed #36908
    11.0.0
  • Null database values treated inconsistently in split vs. non-split Include queries #36907

Closed

  • EFCore 9.0 does not respect [Required] on [Owned] properties belonging to a generic CLR type #35669
  • [9 regression] No coercion operator is defined between types #36873
  • Performance regression with PrimitiveCollections using a complex ValueConverter #36856
    11.0.0
  • ExecuteSqlRawAsync and SqlQueryRaw should be annotated to allow nullable `object?` parameters #35813
    11.0.0
  • Update EFCore.AspNet.Specification.Tests dependencies #34485
    11.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix UpdateExpression.VisitChildren() to retain Tags #36910

Merged

  • Remove tests using IdentityServer4.EntityFramework #36890
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #36909
  • [release/9.0-staging] Fix performance degradation in converters because the instance was not reused #36897
    ask-mode
  • [GA] Fix performance degradation in converters because the instance was not reused #36898
    ask-mode
  • Fix performance degradation in converters because the instance was not reused #36895
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #36906
  • Some NRT testing tweaks #36905
  • Correct nullable annotations on raw SQL APIs #36902
  • [release/10.0-rc2] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #36899
